purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical clinics. It implements a disease-name (Byomei) search and registration screen component (component C04), handling initialization, screen transitions, user input, and master-file lookups for disease codes. It is a subprogram called via the ORCA MCP (Message Control Program) framework.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt software)

Extensive use of COPY for screen areas (C02.INC through C11.INC, CERR.INC, CID*.INC)

verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comment text, which appears garbled in the latin-1 rendering. This is normal for ORCA project source files. The program is clearly a production-grade subprogram within the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) system ORCA, developed by JMA. The 'online-cics' program_type label is used loosely here — the program uses the ORCA MCP event-driven framework rather than CICS, but the interaction model (screen events, PUTG/CLICKED, window management) is analogous.
